title: Very hard to clean.
text: Very hard to clean.. Although the suction was great, it is very hard to clean if you do not have a garbage disposal since there is a lot of food left in grinder.

product_metadata.title: Manual Meat Grinder with Stainless Steel Blades Heavy Duty Powerful Suction Base for Home Use Fast and Effortless for All Meats-Red
features: 【EASY TO USE】: Simply place the pieces of meat into the grinder and turn the hand crank. No electricity needed. It is a good helper to make meatballs, egg, salad, chicken burger, especially for baby food.

【GOOD QUALITY】: Heavy duty plastic body and stainless steel blades ensure durability. Powerful and fast to grinding all meat. Blades, sausage stuffer tubes, handle replacement are available now, don’t worry about losing parts anymore!

【UNIQUE DESIGN】: Powerful suction base ensure to keep this meat grinder in place while you are using it. A great improvement on its capacity. The hopper size has been enlarged for grinding more meat or other food every single time.
【SAFE FOR KITCHEN】: Blades are fully enclosed so it is extremely safe to use. Ergonomic handle design and stable body with non-slip bottom rubber makes grinding smooth and safe.

【SOME SUGGESTIONS】: Please choose a no water and smooth counter and place the meat grinder on the edge of it, then press it to expel the air from the suction cup, and turn down the knob to make the suction base suck on it .The suction works well in this way.
